CIRCUIT: five inverting op-amp stages, each with a reactive feedback element and a 1k series input resistor, plus a right-hand 1k summing bus. Stage A = op-amp #2 (1uF #0 feedback, driven by the 5V source #3). Stage B = #4 (1uH #1 feedback, driven from A through R #5). Stage C = #14 (1uH #10 feedback, driven by the 10A source #15). Stage D = #11 (1uF #9 feedback, driven from C through R #12). Stage E = #21 (1uH #17 feedback, driven from C through cap #19). Outputs of B, D and E all land on a common vertical bus at x~985 through R #6, R #13 and R #22.

  S24 (460,534) J - the ONLY genuine junction/crossing call in this image: the x=462 vertical (op-amp B in+ down to cap #19) crosses the y=533 horizontal (op-amp C output to R #12) as a 4-way. inkmap at (461,533) shows a symmetric filled blob roughly 11 x 10 px against a 3 px stroke width, i.e. a real solder dot, so JUNCTION.
